records.excerpt: The Office for National Statistics publishes the Online ONS Postcode Directory Live dataset for May 2026 and identifies the official ArcGIS FeatureServer access URL.
records.web_line_scope: official dataset summary, May 2026 currency, live postcode scope and REST Feature Access Service URL
records.record_scope: official publisher, dataset epoch and API access route

records.excerpt: Layer 1 ONSPD_LATEST_UK_Live is a point feature layer whose fields include PCDS, LAD25CD, WD25CD, CTRY25CD, RGN25CD, OA21CD, LSOA21CD, MSOA21CD, RUC21IND, LAT and LONG.
records.web_line_scope: official layer id, display field, geometry type, query support and listed field definitions
records.record_scope: official ArcGIS layer schema and bounded query capability

records.excerpt: The ONS Postcode Directory links current and terminated UK postcodes to administrative, health and other geographies and is released quarterly free of charge through the Open Geography portal.
records.web_line_scope: official ONSPD purpose, allocation methodology, release cadence and free availability sections
records.record_scope: official product purpose and postcode-to-geography interpretation boundary

records.excerpt: ONS states that postcode products derived from Code-Point Open are subject to the Open Government Licence and require ONS, OS and Royal Mail attribution statements for Great Britain data.
records.web_line_scope: terms of supply and postcode-products copyright/reproduction sections
records.record_scope: official licence, attribution and third-party-rights boundary
